Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).
        run: |

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).
        run: |

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do

               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).
        run: |

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do

               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).
        run: |

agents-gate:
    needs: [agents-suite]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Fail unless every shard succeeded
        if: needs.agents-suite.result != 'success'
        run: |
          echo "agents-suite result: ${{ needs.agents-suite.result }}" >&2

Tool error (bash): name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty

      - name: Fail unless every shard succeeded
        if: needs.agents-suite.result != 'success'

          exit 1
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        if: needs.agents-suite.result == 'success'
        run: |
          pattern: count-*
          path: shard-counts
      - name: Merge shard coverage
        if: needs.static.result == 'success' && needs.test.result == 'success'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq lcov
          mkdir -p coverage
          ARGS=$(for f in coverage-shards/lcov-*/lcov.info; do printf -- '-a %s ' "$f"; done)
          lcov $ARGS -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: Sum shard test counts
        id: counts
        if: needs.static.result == 'success' && needs.test.result == 'success'

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # agents/ — the machine-wiring tests (test/machine_kit/) resolve
          # the runner configs' parents under agents/ (a submodule); without
          # the checkout, RunCommandProcessor dies with PathNotFoundException.
          submodules: true
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
